description: Header file defining the NdkVideoEncodeAccelerator class for Android GPU video encoding using MediaCodec, including method declarations, class members, and external dependencies.

classes.name: NdkVideoEncodeAccelerator
classes.description: Final class implementing video encoding acceleration on Android using NDK MediaCodec.
